name: JailJudge
intro: JailJudge 是一个可解释的越狱裁判基准与训练框架。它从六类有害提示和多种安全/不安全模型回答构建 35K+ 条训练数据，并提供 4,500 条非多语言 ID 测试数据与十种语言 6,300 条 OOD 测试数据。JailJudge MultiAgent 以 3 个初判、3 个投票和 1 个推理 Agent 生成解释与 1–10 分，再以 LoRA 微调 JAILJUDGE Guard；Guard 的二元越狱阈值为 score > 2。
org: HKUST (Guangzhou), University of Birmingham, Baidu, HKUST
build_method: 人工标注, 自动生成, 多智能体蒸馏
metric: 准确率, 精确率, 召回率, F1, 解释质量（EQ）, 人工解释一致率（H-score）
language: 英文, 中文, 多语言
task_type: 越狱裁判, 二元分类, 细粒度评分
eval_feature: 对抗性, 多语言, 可解释
scale: 35K+ 训练; 4,500 ID; 6,300 OOD（十种语言）
task_type_en: Jailbreak Judging, Binary Classification, Fine-grained Scoring
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Automated Generation, Multi-agent Distillation
intro_en: JailJudge is an explainable jailbreak-judge benchmark and training framework. It builds 35K+ training items from six harmful-prompt sources and diverse safe/unsafe model responses, with 4,500 non-multilingual ID test items and 6,300 OOD items across ten languages. JailJudge MultiAgent uses three judging, three voting, and one inference agent to generate explanations and 1–10 scores, then LoRA-tunes JAILJUDGE Guard; the Guard binary jailbreak threshold is score > 2.
scale_en: 35K+ train; 4,500 ID; 6,300 OOD across ten languages
metric_en: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, Explainability Quality (EQ), Human agreement (H-score)

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.12855v2 Sections 3–5 and Appendices 8–12, official Git commit 8743c1364bd9fde2bd680109c70d18942c1f4394, dataset revision edcd9ae1954452f729768823f74702aef3ed074e, and Guard revision cf624b8a82a174e7cde32a17e2553072d557dc3e. Six harmful-prompt sources and closed-source, open-source, and defense-enhanced responses form candidate prompt-response pairs before the benchmark branches. JAILJUDGE ID is a 4,500-item non-multilingual test split; JAILJUDGE OOD contains 6,300 multilingual items in ten languages, all absent from JAILJUDGETRAIN. Annotators train on nine MLCommons-derived policies, compare manual and GPT-4 labels, re-label mismatches, and use majority voting for binary gold labels. The resulting ground-truth branch contains 35K+ explainable JAILJUDGETRAIN items. The paper configuration uses GPT-4 with three judging agents, three voting agents, and one inference agent. Each judge emits a reason and score from 1 to 10; scores become BPAs, alpha = 0.1 quantifies BPA uncertainty, and Dempster's rule combines evidence. Alpha is not the binary-label threshold. Voting agents accept or reject the aggregated judgment with explanations, and the inference agent consumes the aggregated judgment plus all votes to produce the final reasoning and score. The generated explanations and scores are used for LoRA supervised fine-tuning of Llama-2-7B into JAILJUDGE Guard. For binary Guard evaluation, score > 2 means jailbroken. Judge evaluation uses JAILJUDGE ID/OOD, JBB Behaviors, and WILDTEST, reporting accuracy, precision, recall, F1, GPT-4 explainability quality from 1 to 5, and supplementary human H-score. The artifact is only partly public: the pinned Hugging Face dataset requires gated access and reports auto/custom license metadata, while code and Guard artifacts are versioned separately.
drawio_artifact_boundary_note: Code is pinned at Git 8743c1364bd9fde2bd680109c70d18942c1f4394. The dataset is pinned at HF edcd9ae1954452f729768823f74702aef3ed074e and is gated with auto/custom license metadata; the Guard model is separately pinned at HF cf624b8a82a174e7cde32a17e2553072d557dc3e. Therefore the package must not be described as wholly ungated public.
drawio_threshold_note: The paper's alpha = 0.1 is the uncertainty hyperparameter in the score-to-BPA transformation, not a binary classification threshold. The JAILJUDGE Guard binary decision threshold is score > 2.
